questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: He said, 'I have just finished my homework.'
options: He said he had just finished his homework.
He said he has just finished his homework.
He said he was just finishing his homework.
He said he would have finished his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had just finished his homework.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the following direct speech? 'If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.'
options: She said that if she had known about the meeting, she would have attended it.
She said that if she knew about the meeting, she would attend it.
She said that if she had known about the meeting, she would attend it.
She said that if she knew about the meeting, she would have attended it.
questions.answer: She said that if she had known about the meeting, she would have attended it.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: By the time we arrived at the station, the train _____ .
Select the correct reported question: 'What time do you think the film will start?' she asked me.
options: She asked me what time I thought the film would start.
She asked me what time do you think the film will start.
She asked me if I thought what time the film would start.
She asked me what time I think the film would start.
questions.answer: She asked me what time I thought the film would start.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses the passive voice?
options: The report was written by John.
The report was written from John.
The report was wrote by John.
questions.answer: The report was written by John.

questions.question: Choose the correct word to complete the idiom: 'Don't _____ your chances.'
Select the correct collocation: You need to _____ your ideas clearly in the presentation.
Which of the following sentences uses a dependent preposition correctly?
options: He gave up smoking for two months.
He gave up smoking during two months.
He gave up smoking over two months.
He gave up smoking since two months.
questions.answer: He gave up smoking for two months.
